# gitlab_project_error_tracking_client_key (Resource)

The `gitlab_project_error_tracking_client_key` resource manages error tracking client keys for a GitLab project.

**Upstream API**: [GitLab REST API docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/error_tracking/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitlab_project" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

resource "gitlab_project_error_tracking_settings" "example" {
  project    = gitlab_project.example.id
  active     = true
  integrated = true
}

resource "gitlab_project_error_tracking_client_key" "example" {
  project = gitlab_project_error_tracking_settings.example.project
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the client key is active.
- `id` (String) The ID of this Terraform resource. In the format `<project>:<key_id>`.
- `key_id` (Number) The ID of the client key.
- `public_key` (String) The public key for the client.
- `sentry_dsn` (String, Sensitive) The Sentry DSN for the client key.
